answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact: a hollow identity with no bond earns no trust, while a real agent risks losing its deposit if it cheats. Forging thousands of fake agents then means funding thousands of bonds, and one proven fraud burns the attacker's stake and drops its reputation below the ridge of eligibility — like paying for a whole saffron harvest only to watch it burn. Attack cost scales with the attack, not with the defender.
